dcterms:description: The NTU RGB+D dataset was specifically collected for the research of large scale RGB-D human action recognition. It contains 56K action samples from 40 subjects performing 60 different actions captured from three different views using a Kinect v2.
dcterms:title: NTU RGB+D Dataset

dcterms:description: The SYSU 3D HOI dataset contains 480 samples from 6 pairs of interaction actions, designed for studying complex actions involving human-object interactions.
dcterms:title: SYSU 3D HOI Dataset
